programme.title: Ananda Yoga
programme.desc: Una sesión de yoga dirigida por Verónica Gamio, una profesora certificada de este arte. Qué es el yoga y cómo beneficia todas las áreas de la vida.

programme.title: Vida Tai Chi
programme.desc: El taichí, además, de un arte marcial también es un arma ideal para ayudar a recuperar la salud.

programme.title: Yoga terapia
programme.desc: Posiciones y posturas que promueven el sentido del equilibro. Estiramientos suaves y meditación para aliviar síntomas molestos. Bienestar físico y psíquico espiritual.

programme.title: De Mujeres
programme.desc: Temas de actualidad enfocados a ayudar a la mujer latina que sufre de problemas como la inmigración, pobreza, falta de oportunidades y discriminación.

programme.title: Good Mood
programme.desc: Un programa que motiva a la gente a estar conscientes de lo que compran en los supermercados y de lo que comen, mostrando los químicos y conservantes que ingresan al cuerpo a la hora de ingerir ciertos productos y cómo hay una opción más saludable.

programme.title: Vive Fit
programme.desc: Las mejores herramientas para estar saludable y en forma. Las mejores rutinas, tips y métodos para experimentar el ejercicio de forma divertida y práctica.

programme.title: Del huerto a la mesa
programme.desc: Un programa que se centra en encontrar una forma correcta y divertida de combinar ingredientes adecuados para cada estilo de alimentación.

programme.title: Vive verde y rebelde
programme.desc: Programa de salud integral que da orientación para una vida saludable y en armonía. Cómo cambiar hábitos y transformar vidas; cómo empezar el día, conectarte con la naturaleza, los superalimentos, ejercicios y tips de hábitos saludables.

programme.title: Crecer sin límites
programme.desc: Un programa que busca generar un cambio personal significativo a través de la promoción de la salud emocional y física.

programme.title: Sendero de luz
programme.desc: Amor, alimentación consciente, energía positiva y otros temas que ayudan a llevar una vida en armonía.

programme.title: Códigos del universo
programme.desc: Propuesta que muestra como liberar y conducir nuestro cuerpo y alma por medio de la medicina alternativa, holística y natural.

programme.title: Medita conmigo

programme.title: Searching for Answers
programme.desc: Iris Muller viaja a las islas Galápagos para reconectar con su interior y obtener respuestas a las preguntas de su corazón. Además, muestra las actividades turísticas de la zona y reflexiona sobre qué se puede hacer para proteger al planeta Tierra.

programme.title: Vive al máximo
programme.desc: Consejos destinados a las personas que buscan un equilibrio mental y espiritual en sus vidas. Tips para mejorar la relación de pareja, la vida sexual, la relación con los hijos, el ejercicio físico, la alimentación o el aspecto y el vestuario.

programme.title: Vive simple: Edición Galápagos
programme.desc: Una emocionante expedición por las fabulosas islas Encantadas para promever hábitos sostenibles en la vida diaria. Además, consejos prácticos y entrevistas inspiradoras.

programme.title: Vive simple
programme.desc: Consejos e indicaciones que promueven cambios saludables en el estilo de vida. Se busca una existencia más simple y basada en un consumo responsable que defiende la sostenibilidad y el ecologismo.

programme.title: Misión verde
programme.desc: La humanidad causó el apocalipsis debido a la contaminación y el abuso de los recursos. Un grupo de rebeldes intentará contactarse con alguien del pasado para tratar de salvar a la Tierra.

programme.title: En busca del sentido común: iniciativas por el bienestar

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 3 Aggies (9-0, 6-0 SEC) line up against the Gamecocks (3-6, 1-6) at Kyle Field. South Carolina won two of the last three meetings, but is 0-5 when facing Texas A&M at College Station. The Aggies are 9-0 for the first time since 1992.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Wolfpack set out to play spoiler once more by visiting the No. 15 Hurricanes. NC State upset then-No. 8 Georgia Tech 48-36 prior to its bye Nov. 1. Freshman Jayden Scott (NCSU) scored and set a new career high with 196 rushing yards in the win.

programme.title: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 7 Rebels (9-1, 5-1 SEC) try to solve the Gators (3-6, 2-4). Florida won the last three meetings to take a 13-12-1 series advantage. Kewan Lacy (MISS) shared the FBS lead with 16 touchdowns and was 10th with 912 rushing yards entering Week 12.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 12 Cougars (8-1, 5-1 Big 12) try to bounce back when they host the Horned Frogs (6-3, 3-3). TCU has won five in a row over BYU after a 44-11 result in 2023 in their first meeting since 2011. BYU fell 29-7 at then-No. 8 Texas Tech on Nov. 8.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Falcons (3-7, 1-5 MAC) duel with the Zips (4-7, 3-4). Bowling Green has won three in a row over Akron, including a 41-14 result at home in 2023. The Zips wrap up their season without a bowl-game appearance for an eighth straight year.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: Greek natives and their kin built the Birmingham restaurant scene, from barbecue joints to hotdog stands to steakhouses. Bright Star, founded in 1907, is the old guard and Johnny's is the new guard Greek restaurant.

programme.title: TrueSouth
programme.desc: Pablo Rivadeneyra rotisserie-cooks lime-marinated chicken. Larry and Betty Jean Scott work a smoke-belching pit at Scott's BBQ. In these two places, we get a glimpse of the hard work that defines life in the South.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 24 Bulls face the Midshipmen in a marquee American Conference tilt. Navy leads the conference with a 5-1 record, but has lost back-to-back games to North Texas and Notre Dame. South Florida is 4-1 in league play after thrashing UTSA 55-23.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 19 Cavaliers (8-2, 5-1) try to maintain their recent mastery of the Blue Devils (5-4, 4-1) in a clash of ACC contenders. Virginia has won eight of the last nine meetings. UVA comes off a 16-9 upset loss at home against Wake Forest.

programme.desc: Herschel Walker overcomes bullying for being overweight and having a severe stutter to become a college football star and win the 1982 Heisman Trophy.

programme.desc: Theater director Lila must rise to the challenge of putting on the perfect Christmas ballet alongside a difficult new colleague, while also discovering her office secret Santa in the process.

programme.title: A Dash of Christmas
programme.desc: To apply for her dream job at a foodie startup, an executive must learn to bake. When she recruits a handsome baker to help her, she inadvertently ends up in a Christmas Bakeoff.

programme.title: A Little Women's Christmas
programme.desc: A contemporary retelling of the classic novel "Little Women," following the lives and loves of the March sisters in a small Tennessee town during Christmastime.

programme.title: A Brush With Christmas
programme.desc: Disheartened and struggling to find time for her art, Charlotte throws out her latest painting, only to discover that it has been anonymously submitted to the Christmas art festival.

programme.title: A Royal Date for Christmas
programme.desc: When a European Duke arrives in the US, he realizes that his bags have been lost in transit; he has no choice but to be styled, and ultimately inspired, by Bella, the owner of a local boutique.

programme.title: Hats Off to Christmas!
programme.desc: Mia, the manager of a small town's Christmas shop, has to train Nick, the owner's son, for a position she coveted. Mia does not like Nick's unreliable ways until he helps convince her disabled son to continue physical therapy so he can walk again.

programme.title: Christmas in Midnight Clear
programme.desc: A real estate developer plans to modernize an economically struggling town from the inside out. However, when she meets the local pastor and pillar of the community, her vision faces more than legal challenges as something deeper begins to blossom.

programme.title: Christmas on the Coast
programme.desc: Needing inspiration, hard-hearted New York novelist Dru Cassadine needs to write the "novel of her life" before Christmas is over, but her newest romance story may just star her and the most eligible bachelor in her hometown.

programme.title: Mrs. Miracle
programme.desc: A single man (James Van Der Beek) hires a nanny (Doris Roberts) to help him care for his 6-year-old twins.

programme.title: Christmas by Candlelight
programme.desc: Juliet pitches selling Christmas memory candles to her boss, and asks candle store owner Tom to create new scents. He refuses at first but agrees after realizing the money will help make his daughter's Christmas wish come true.

programme.title: Christmas of Giving
programme.desc: Belle Carter has devoted her whole life to making the holidays bright for those in need. With Christmas approaching and the community's hopes hanging in the balance, she discovers believing in the best of people is the greatest gift of all.

programme.title: Pencil Me in for Christmas
programme.desc: An aspiring illustrator teams up with a demanding author to work on a children's book. As they create their Christmas-themed project in a nostalgic small town, they find themselves rediscovering the holiday spirit.

programme.title: Our Christmas Wedding
programme.desc: Roles reverse as Nicole's boss plans newly engaged Nicole and Michael's wedding in two weeks at Christmas.

programme.title: A Christmas Prayer
programme.desc: Struggling with creative burnout, a children's book illustrator finds unexpected inspiration when she learns about a girl's Christmas wish for her recently widowed father to find happiness again.

programme.title: Christmas in the Smokies
programme.desc: A family must save its Smoky Mountains berry farm against all odds.

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.

programme.title: Christmas Is You
programme.desc: An office assistant is faced with a dilemma when her record-executive boss tells her to convince her ex-boyfriend to sign with their label, or look for a new job.

programme.title: A Very Curious Christmas
programme.desc: A rising star reporter must uncover the identity of a local late-night bandit who has been stealing beautiful home Christmas displays across the city.

programme.title: A Royal Christmas on Ice
programme.desc: Looking to escape his royal life, a dashing prince comes to the United States to start a business in a small town in upstate New York and winds up falling for a former Olympic ice skater.

programme.title: Christmas on Windmill Way
programme.desc: Mia Miejer expects that her Mimi will win the Christmas Market Dutch Bake-Off competition, but her Mimi has difficult news to share: she must sell the deed to their Windmill Way property, which has been in their family for generations.

programme.title: Royally Wrapped for Christmas
programme.desc: Lindsay, the NY director of an international charity organization, is called to the Kingdom of Veronia by the royal family to interview for the job of overseeing the whole operation. During the interview process, she finds true love with the prince.

programme.title: Joy for Christmas
programme.desc: A publicist introduces a famous athlete to the joys of Christmas in the hopes that he will assist her in saving her family's annual charity.

programme.title: Angel Falls Christmas
programme.desc: A devoted doctor with little time for the Christmas spirit is in desperate need of an intervention from the unlikeliest of places.
